items: 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔 𝐋𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐀𝐧𝐝𝐫𝐨𝐢𝐝 𝟏𝟔 𝐓𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐞𝐭 - Android 16 tablets feature advanced security and privacy protections to ensure your data and internet communications remain highly secure. They support customizable permission management for robust data protection. The AI-optimized system integrates new features like a sidebar, floating action buttons, gesture controls, and dark mode. Its clean interface uses oversized icons and simplified menus, making it easy for seniors, children, and tech beginners to navigate.

𝟏𝟑.𝟏𝟓-𝐢𝐧𝐜𝐡 𝐒𝐜𝐫𝐞𝐞𝐧 | 𝟏𝟔𝟎𝟎*𝟐𝟐𝟒𝟎 - Featuring a 13.15-inch IPS screen that delivers ample workspace, while its narrow bezel design expands your field of view. With a 178° viewing angle, it's truly perfect for family sharing. Paired with a 1600*2240 ultra-high resolution, it reveals richer visual details. The 90Hz refresh rate ensures smooth motion transitions, delivering a more immersive viewing experience.

𝟒𝟎𝐆𝐁 𝐑𝐀𝐌 + 𝟏𝟐𝟖𝐆𝐁 𝐑𝐎𝐌 + 𝐎𝐜𝐭𝐚-𝐜𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐂𝐏𝐔 - Equipped with 8GB physical memory and up to 32GB virtual memory (default 18GB). Effortlessly handle multitasking without lag. 128GB storage expandable up to 2TB via TF card slot, easily storing your favorite files and app data. Equipped with the powerful Unisco T7300 CPU, featuring a core frequency of up to 2.2GHz, effortlessly runs various heavy-duty games and apps.The 6nm manufacturing process reduces power consumption and minimizes heat generation.

𝟏𝟏𝟎𝟎𝟎𝐦𝐀𝐡 𝐁𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐲 + 𝐃𝐮𝐚𝐥-𝐛𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐖𝐢-𝐅𝐢 - The 11,000mAh high-capacity battery delivers 12+ hours of battery life and comes with PD 20W fast charging, fully charging within 3 hours, completely eliminate battery anxiety. Enjoy all-day use on a single charge. This tablet supports dual-band Wi-Fi (2.4GHz + 5GHz) — intelligently switching between signals for strong signal penetration. Enjoy a fast and stable internet connection, ensuring you never miss a single important moment.

𝐒𝐦𝐚𝐫𝐭 𝐃𝐮𝐚𝐥 𝐂𝐚𝐦𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐬 +𝐆𝐨𝐨𝐠𝐥𝐞 𝐆𝐞𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐢 𝐀𝐈 - Equipped with high-definition 13MP rear camera and 8MP front camera, not only captures vivid daily photos but also delivers smart features through deep integration with Google Search. Instantly identify objects, solve homework problems, and unlock devices with facial recognition. Powered by the built-in Google Gemini AI, its advanced capabilities make it your essential assistant for work and study.
